summary.jupiterFormat: address (mint), symbol, name, decimals, logoURI, chainId
summary.openOceanFormat: address, symbol, name, decimals, icon, chainId
summary.coinGeckoFormat: address, symbol, name, decimals, logoURI, chainId

CoinGecko wraps tokens in a "tokens" array
